text:
```yaml
name: Claude PR Critique

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  claude-critique:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: web

      - name: Run web checks
        run: |
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck
          npm test
        working-directory: web

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: apps

      - name: Run apps checks
        run: |
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck
        working-directory: apps

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: electron

      - name: Run electron checks
        run: |
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck
          npm test
        working-directory: electron

      - name: Claude PR Critique
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt: |
            Please provide a short critique of this pull request.
            Focus on code quality, potential bugs, and best practices.
            Keep the critique concise and actionable.
          anthropic_model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
```
